lines.en: This is it, Diana.  Can't you feel the power crackling beneath you?  Exhilirating...
lines.zh: 戴安娜，就是这里。 你感觉不到能量在你的脚下噼啪作响吗？ 太让人兴奋了……
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: This is surreal....  The closer I get to the shrine, the rest of you seem to disappear...
lines.zh: 太神奇了…… 我越靠近神殿，你们就变得越发透明……
lines.name: 戴安娜
